commentary_segments.text_raw:
The equivalent input noise
voltage of a MOST can be
made small by increasing
the transconductance. This
will require a small V −V
GS T
but a large W/L and current.
This is only true if the
Gate resistance is small. In
this layout a MOST is
shown with very large W/L.
The poly Gate lines between
the Sources and Drains have
become very long, generat-
ing a fairly large resistance.
In order to avoid this
resistance, it is better to
divide the layout in several smaller blocks, such that the Gate contacts can be much closer to
the middle of the Gate lines.
The Gate resistance therefore depends very much on the layout style.
commentary_segments.text: The equivalent input noise voltage of a MOST can be made small by increasing the transconductance. This will require a small V −V GS T but a large W/L and current. This is only true if the Gate resistance is small. In this layout a MOST is shown with very large W/L. The poly Gate lines between the Sources and Drains have become very long, generating a fairly large resistance. In order to avoid this resistance, it is better to divide the layout in several smaller blocks, such that the Gate contacts can be much closer to the middle of the Gate lines. The Gate resistance therefore depends very much on the layout style.
